definitions.explanation: Craft items made by hand rather than by machine. Encompasses a wide range of creative activities including knitting, weaving, pottery, leatherwork, and other manual arts.

examples.japanese: {手工芸|しゅこうげい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧です。
⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手工芸|しゅこうげい}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧にした。
examples.english: I got local handicrafts as souvenirs.

examples.japanese: {手工芸|しゅこうげい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{編|あ}み{物|もの}→編み物：06364_amimono⟧や⟦{刺繍|ししゅう}→刺繍：05411_shishuu⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: In handicraft classes, you can learn knitting, embroidery, and more.

notes:
Composed of {手|しゅ} (hand) and ⟦{工芸|こうげい}→工芸：04182_kougei⟧ (craft, applied art). Emphasizes the handmade quality of the work, in contrast to machine-produced goods.

USAGE:
Used both for the activity/hobby and for the resulting products. {手工芸|しゅこうげい}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ refers to handcrafted items. Common in the context of hobby shops, craft classes, and artisan markets.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手工芸|しゅこうげい}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ — handicraft item, handmade goods
- {手工芸|しゅこうげい}⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧ — handicraft class
- {手工芸|しゅこうげい}⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧ — handicraft artist
- ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧{手工芸|しゅこうげい} — traditional handicraft

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{工芸|こうげい}→工芸：04182_kougei⟧ — craft, applied art; broader term including machine-assisted work
- ⟦{民芸|みんげい}→民芸：19768_mingei⟧ — folk craft; specifically traditional crafts of ordinary people
- ⟦{手芸|しゅげい}→手芸：07062_shugei⟧ — needlework, sewing crafts; more specific to textile-based handwork
